causalClaims.explanation: ADR-042 explicitly documents that Trading OS SHALL maintain explicit, mode-specific position authority with PAPER_POSITION_AUTHORITY = TRADING_CORE. PAPER entry and exit commands use local simulated fills and PAPER settlement mutates local Account and Trade state with atomic transactions. PAPER mode execution SHALL share concepts with LIVE mode such as human authorization, idempotency, deterministic safety validation, execution audit, and provider-neutral outcome concepts only where meanings overlap, but must keep authority, mutation mechanics, and reconciliation assumptions mode-specific and distinct. PAPER full close is represented as a local EXIT with explicit purpose and local Open Trade target, supporting only full close with no partial close or exposure reversal. Risk evaluation for PAPER exit uses deterministic reducing-exit validation without requiring entry-only trade plan approval. PAPER settlement cannot silently complete without financial state. Local PAPER position projection uses legacy Trade entity as minimal and authoritative local state. Market Data provides valuation inputs but does not own position lifecycle. PAPER exit does not call Broker Service APIs. These architectural and domain constraints establish the boundaries and requirements that must be maintained if PAPER execution or settlement is changed.
